newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos Chihuahua raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cementos Chihuahua raised.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Interacciones said on Wednesday raised its rating on cement company Cementos de Chihuahua SA to a buy from a hold.
Analyst Jaime Fernandez said he was reviewing downwards the expected growth of the company's 1997 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
But he said the shares are trading at a heavy discount compared to its peers in the Mexican cement industry.
Cementos de Chihuahua B series shares were up four centavos to 9.12 pesos in midday trade on the Mexican bourse.
